rules.description: Applicant must hold a valid UK driving licence
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only notify DVLA of a medical condition if you hold a UK driving licence

rules.description: Applicant must be a GB resident (not Northern Ireland)
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for Great Britain residents. Northern Ireland residents must use a different process.

rules.description: Condition must be on DVLA's list of notifiable medical conditions
rules.reason_if_failed: Your condition is not on the list of conditions that must be reported to DVLA. You do not need to take action.

rules.description: For online notification, must have car or motorcycle licence only
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use the online service for bus, lorry or coach licences. You must check the A-Z list and complete a paper form.

rules.description: Applicant must acknowledge the legal duty to notify and potential penalties
rules.reason_if_failed: You must acknowledge that failing to notify DVLA can result in a fine up to £1,000 and may invalidate your insurance

explanation_template: Medical condition notification requirement: {outcome}. Legal duty: Failure to notify can result in fines up to £1,000 and invalidated insurance.

edge_cases.description: Doctor has advised to stop driving for 3 months or more
edge_cases.action: Offer voluntary licence surrender. Must still notify DVLA even if surrendering licence.

edge_cases.description: Condition currently affects ability to drive safely
edge_cases.action: Immediate notification required. Consider voluntary licence surrender. Do not drive until DVLA assessment complete.

edge_cases.description: Condition requires paper form submission rather than online notification
edge_cases.action: Direct user to print appropriate form from A-Z list. Cannot complete online.
Each condition must be reported separately. User may need multiple forms or online notifications.

edge_cases.description: Applicant holds bus, lorry or coach licence
edge_cases.action: Cannot use online service. Must use A-Z list to find condition-specific form.

edge_cases.description: Previously reported condition has significantly worsened
edge_cases.action: Must notify DVLA of change in condition. May require new medical assessment.
